proposals: The Ministry of Textiles should publish PLI Textiles results by HS chapter and product, separating MMF apparel, MMF fabric and technical textiles, so the ₹733 crore of exports reported so far can be set against the $15.8 billion that HS 61 and 62 apparel already export.

DPIIT should require every PLI scheme to report beneficiaries’ export sales separately from domestic sales, and publish the totals each year, as Bulk Drugs already does, so incentives earned on domestic growth alone are not read as export support.

The Department of Commerce should publish an annual export-concentration statement by HS chapter, giving each chapter’s top destination share and a concentration index, so reliance on one market — the USA appearing among top destinations in 11 of 12 growth chapters — is tracked officially.

The Ministry of Heavy Industries should publish year by year the PLI Auto incentive paid and the exports of eligible advanced-technology vehicles and components by beneficiaries, so the near-tripled ₹5,939.87 crore allocation for 2026-27 can be tied to results in HS 87.
